env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This runtime eval builds and deploys a headless standalone Archive Search deployment as a delta on the current `search` developer profile, from ingestion and indexing through a query round-trip. Detection flows through `mdx-raw`; embeddings flow `rtvi-embed -> mdx-embed -> vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion -> mdx-embed-filtered` before Elasticsearch; behaviors flow through `mdx-behavior`; the populated index is then queried back with `vss search run`. RT-VLM critique and the agent tier are excluded. RT-CV detector artifacts are host-staged per the RT-CV owner contract before bring-up and the SigLIP vision encoder is fetched by `perception-2d-init`. The build label is directory metadata only.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build and deploy under `_builds/search-standalone-runtime/`: "Provide live and on-demand VIOS ingestion, warehouse RT-DETR detection and tracking with per-object SigLIP embeddings on RT-CV, and video/chunk embeddings on RT-Embed. Create behaviors and filter embeddings with the unified SearchAndAlertsApp and index the write path into Elasticsearch. Keep media retrievable and the index browsable through the analytics API." Target `{{platform}}`; keep the deployment headless with no agent, UI, Phoenix, LLM NIM, or RT-VLM critique; provision RT-CV and RT-Embed by direct REST from VIOS per `references/stream-provisioning.md`; validate before deployment, prove both upload and live RTSP paths, query the populated index back with the search CLI per `references/query.md`, and leave services running.
checks: `_builds/search-standalone-runtime/override.env` exists with `FOUNDATION=search`, a full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`, and only customized environment values.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion,vss-video-analytics-api-fusion,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-init,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,rtvi-embed,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`; explicitly excluded keys, including `rtvi-vlm`, `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `vss-haproxy-ingress`, `phoenix`, and every `llm_*`/`vlm_*` NIM key, are absent.

`RTVI_EMBED_KAFKA_ENABLED=true`, `RTVI_EMBED_KAFKA_TOPIC=mdx-embed`, and `ELASTICSEARCH_ENABLE_EMBEDDINGS=true` are effective, and Behavior Analytics is selected as the producer of `mdx-embed-filtered`.
`ENABLE_CRITIC=false` is effective because RT-VLM critique was excluded, and no `models-download-search`, `models-download.json`, or `vss-rtvi-cv-init` reference is introduced.
`COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains no build label, aggregate profile, or invented service key.

`_builds/search-standalone-runtime/compose.yml` includes `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml`, `patches/` is absent, and the build directory contains the three required primary artifacts (`override.env`, `compose.yml`, and `resolved.yml`) with no copied Foundation `.env`, copied root Compose project, patched tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated skill bundle.

Four-layer resolution uses `containers.env`, Search `.env`, Search `overrides.env`, and the build `override.env` with the build `compose.yml`; normalized `resolved.yml` validates directly, all selected keys resolve, no service retains a `profiles:` gate, no real `${...}` interpolation remains unresolved, no `/path/to/deploy/docker` or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel remains, and every checked-in bind source exists with the expected file/directory type.
Deployment uses exactly `_builds/search-standalone-runtime/resolved.yml` without re-reading Foundation env files or supplying a profile flag.
All selected long-running containers are running or healthy, all selected one-shot containers exit 0, and excluded services (including `rtvi-vlm` and the agent tier) are not running.
`curl -sf http://localhost:${RTVI_CV_HOST_PORT:-9000}/ready` returns HTTP 200 and RT-Embed readiness responds successfully.
An uploaded video remains retrievable through VIOS and produces both RT-CV detection output and RT-Embed embedding output.

A live NvStreamer synthetic RTSP source is registered through VIOS; its VIOS live-proxy URL (`rtsp://${HOST_IP}:30554/live/<sensorId>`) is discovered by reading `/sensor/<sensorId>/streams` — retried with backoff past an empty/404 first read, never constructed and never replaced by the raw NvStreamer RTSP — and both RT-CV and RT-Embed are driven from that discovered proxy URL.
Kafka end offsets for `mdx-raw`, `mdx-embed`, `mdx-embed-filtered`, and `mdx-behavior` are recorded before and after processing and all increase.

Elasticsearch contains detection documents (`mdx-raw-*`), behavior documents (`mdx-behavior-*`), and filtered-embedding documents (`mdx-embed-filtered-*`) attributable to the processed media, and the filtered-embedding index carries a populated dense_vector field.

A `vss search run` query against the deployed build — endpoints and indexes resolved from `_builds/search-standalone-runtime/resolved.yml` per `references/query.md`, with no `--deployment`/`--profile` selector — returns ranked results for the ingested media from the populated `mdx-embed-filtered-*` index, proving the read path round-trips.

No duplicate Kafka or Elasticsearch stack is deployed, no incident or verification index is created (no `alert-bridge`, `mdx-incidents`, or `mdx-vlm-incidents`), no file under `deploy/docker/` is modified, and the final response reports the Foundation, delta, changed knobs, readiness, playback, Kafka offsets, Elasticsearch evidence, and the query round-trip result.
